subject: Child Tax Credit (tax refund per child)
query: how much tax refund per child 2026
title: How much is the tax refund per child in 2026? Up to $2,200 credit
answer: For returns filed in 2026 (tax year 2025), the Child Tax Credit is worth up to $2,200 per qualifying child under 17. It first lowers the tax you owe; if the credit is larger than your tax, up to $1,700 per child can come back as a refund through the Additional Child Tax Credit. The same $2,200 and $1,700 apply to tax year 2026.
body:
So there is no flat "refund per child." How much you actually get back depends on your tax bill and your earnings. Example: if your federal income tax before credits is $1,000 and you have one qualifying child, $1,000 of the credit wipes out your tax, and up to $1,200 of the rest could be refundable, but no more than the $1,700 cap. The refundable part also depends on earned income: you need at least $2,500 of earned income, and the refundable amount builds up at 15% of earnings above $2,500.

Who qualifies: the child must be under 17 at the end of the year; be your son, daughter, stepchild, eligible foster child, sibling, step-sibling, half-sibling, or a descendant of one of them; live with you more than half the year; not provide more than half of their own support; be claimed as your dependent; and be a U.S. citizen, national or resident alien. You, your spouse if filing jointly, and the child need Social Security numbers valid for work, issued by the return's due date.

Income limits: the full credit is available with modified adjusted gross income up to $200,000, or $400,000 for married couples filing jointly. Above that, it shrinks by $50 for each $1,000 of income over the limit. For dependents who don't qualify, such as a 17-year-old or an older relative you support, the Credit for Other Dependents is worth up to $500 each, and it is not refundable.

Timing: by law, the IRS cannot send any part of a refund that includes the Additional Child Tax Credit or the Earned Income Tax Credit before mid-February, even if you file in January. Check your status with the IRS "Where's My Refund?" tool.

faq.q: How much is the child tax credit for 2025 taxes?
faq.a: Up to $2,200 per qualifying child, with up to $1,700 refundable.

faq.q: How much is the child tax credit in 2026?
faq.a: For tax year 2026, it remains up to $2,200 per child, with up to $1,700 refundable.

faq.q: Do I get $2,200 per child back as a refund?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The credit first reduces your tax; only up to $1,700 per child can be paid out as a refund beyond what you owe.

faq.q: Can I get the child tax credit with no income?
faq.a: No refundable portion is available unless you have at least $2,500 of earned income.

faq.q: When will I get my refund if I claim the child tax credit?
faq.a: The IRS can't issue refunds that include the Additional Child Tax Credit before mid-February.
